name: Financial Instrument Status Report V 01
definition: The InstrumentStatusReport message is sent by the Trading Venue to the Consolidated Tape Provider, which disseminates the data to their users on a consolidated basis. The InstrumentStatusReport message contains the latest trading status of financial instruments on a per-venue basis, including information such as whether an instrument is active, suspended, halted, or removed, along with its current trading phase.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Provides general information on the instruments report.

InstrumentReport.name: Instrument Report
InstrumentReport.definition: Report related to the status of financial instruments traded on a given venue.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
